args.question: I could not find any information regarding the account list for groups with multiple members. Could you please provide some clarification on this?

tool_trajectory.result: The account list refers to the array of unique member account IDs (member_accindexes) that are part of the identified clusters with multiple members. This is captured in the `array_agg(DISTINCT pa.accindex)` function in the SQL query, which aggregates the unique account indexes into an array for each cluster.

args.sql:
WITH potential_amplification_activity AS (
    SELECT 
        ma.modactkey,
        ma.clustsize AS total_member_count,
        ma.coordscore AS top_coordination_score,
        array_agg(DISTINCT a.accindex) AS account_list
    FROM 
        moderationaction AS ma
    JOIN 
        securitydetection AS sd ON ma.masedetref = sd.secdetkey
    JOIN 
        account AS a ON a.accindex = sd.sectechref -- Assuming sectechref references the account
    WHERE 
        ma.clustsize > 1 
    GROUP BY 
        ma.modactkey, ma.clustsize, ma.coordscore, sd.detecttime
),
platform_grouped AS (
    SELECT 
        a.plattype, 
        a.platident AS platform_id,
        sd.detecttime AS time,
        paa.total_member_count, 
        paa.top_coordination_score,
        paa.account_list
    FROM 
        potential_amplification_activity AS paa
    JOIN 
        securitydetection AS sd ON paa.modactkey = sd.secdetkey
    JOIN 
        account AS a ON a.accindex = sd.sectechref
)
SELECT 
    *
FROM 
    platform_grouped;
